text:
alex.s: Handoff: MediQuery Labs (health analytics). MRR $19k, BAA signed. Pilot go-live planned 2026-04-11. Requires private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, strict PHI logging and KMS integration. Sales mentioned a likely spike on pilot (roughly 650 reqs/min). Main blockers: SAML metadata delay, TLS certs, peering maintenance window. cc @nina @ryan

nina: Ill lead onboarding + enablement. Quick Q: who is the Okta admin and do we have their SAML XML? Also need to know if they manage certs or want us to assist.

alex.s: Okta admin is ops+id@mediquery.com. Sales uploaded a placeholder SAML file in the account folder (internal). Customer plans to manage TLS certs but asked for step-by-step instructions.

ryan: I opened ENG-6120 for VPC peering and SUP-8127 for SSO support. Eng needs final CIDR ranges and preferred peering date/time. Left a comment for ops+id@mediquery.com on ENG-6120.

infra-bot: ENG-6120 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

nina: Action list Ill track: 1) Collect final SAML XML from ops+id@mediquery.com (owner: nina, due: 2026-03-29) 2) Share cert guide + sample commands (owner: alex.s, due: 2026-03-25) 3) ENG preflight + ENG-6120 (owner: ryan) 4) Host enablement + PHI runbook (owner: nina, session: 2026-04-06) 5) Pilot surge plan (owner: ops, note: request temporary burst capacity)

alex.s: They want a go/no-go sync on 2026-04-03. Please call out blockers by 2026-03-31. Also flagging renewal planning: 12mo term, recommend QBR at month 7 to review adoption.

ryan: Quick smoke test for CS to validate staging when ready:

curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"input":"PHI test: Patient Lee, MRN 88473"}'

nina: Will run the smoke test and validate redaction/logging. Ill build the Confluence onboarding page and add runbook + ticket links, will post the link here when ready. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up 2026-03-29 09:30 PT.

alex.s: Thanks team, available to join cert or peering calls.
